RAY COOKE AUCTIONEERS are delighted to present this extended three-bedroom mid-terrace family home to the market, ideally positioned on Marigold Avenue, a mature and established residential location in the heart of Dublin 17.

No. 119 offers bright and well-proportioned accommodation extending to c.79 sq.m and is sure to appeal to a wide variety of purchasers including first-time buyers, growing families, and investors alike. The property has been extended to the rear, providing additional living space and offering an excellent opportunity for the new owner to create a wonderful family home in a highly convenient location.

The location is second to none with every conceivable amenity within arm's reach including schools, shops, sporting facilities, and recreational amenities. Clarehall Shopping Centre, Northside Shopping Centre and Donaghmede Shopping Centre are all within easy reach. The area is also very well serviced by public transport with numerous bus routes nearby whilst the M1, M50 and Dublin Airport are all easily accessible.

Bright and spacious internal living accommodation of c.79 sq.m comprises of entrance hallway, living room, kitchen/dining area and extended living accommodation to the rear. Upstairs hosts three well-proportioned bedrooms and a family bathroom.

No. 119 benefits from gas fired central heating, double glazed windows throughout and a driveway to the front providing valuable off-street parking. While requiring some updating to meet modern tastes, this property presents an excellent opportunity for the new owner to put their own stamp on a spacious home in a well-established residential setting with every amenity on its doorstep.

Early viewing is highly advised. Contact Ray Cooke Auctioneers today on 0868323302 or 015411455 for further information or to arrange a viewing.
